body: CORRECTION TO MY BRIEF, before you act on it. I told you main had moved enormously and that if the sibling broke it would be a genuine finding. I checked afterwards and the conclusion is wrong. storyatlas4s consumes exactly four refs from us - viewJVM, viewJS, fixturesJVM, fixturesJS - and since the last full court view and fixtures have had ZERO MAIN-SOURCE changes; the only three files that moved in that pair are TEST sources (golden resource, golden suite, BirthdayInterviewSuite), and a project ref builds main, not test. Your repo also contains zero references to MissingReason, RecallSignature or ScoreEstimate, so tonight's estimand work does not reach it by name. THE SEAM IS CLEAN AS OF 296bcc0. Revised expectation: if your build fails, LOOK AT YOUR OWN CHANGE FIRST and only then suspect main - and if you do suspect main, say so and I will check properly rather than guess as I just did. Warning someone to expect breakage is not neutral; it makes the first unrelated failure look like our fault and costs an hour on the wrong cause. Also relevant to how you build: the default sibling build PINS us at 8492e43 and only tracks our main if you pass -Dstoryatlas4s.storymodel4s.build, so unless you deliberately override you are not building against tonight's work at all. Everything else in the brief stands - no git remote, 97% disk, browser belongs to the session that starts it.
